name: brawlistan-web
description: Build step for BRAWLISTAN's WebGPU holographic cards (docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-117). The rest of web/ is plain static files.

scripts.build: esbuild web-src/holo/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --loader:.wgsl=text --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/*! BRAWLISTAN holographic cards (docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-117). Built from web-src/holo with npm run build; do not edit. Includes vgpu 0.5.0 and the vGPU holographic-card example, MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 Vercel, Inc. */" --outfile=web/assets/js/holo.js
